name: com.useorgx/orgx-mcp
title: OrgX MCP — Organizational Memory for AI Agents
description: Organizational memory and agent orchestration MCP. Remember decisions, artifacts, tasks, and project context across Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and other agents.

tools.name: remember_decision
tools.description: Save a decision to organizational memory so agents and teammates can recall it later. Also known as: decision log, team memory, agent memory, record decision, remember what we decided.

tools.name: recall_memory
tools.description: Search organizational memory for prior decisions, artifacts, project context, and team knowledge. Also known as: search memory, recall decisions, find context, retrieve artifacts, what did we decide.

tools.name: approve_agent_work
tools.description: Review agent decisions or work items awaiting human approval. Also known as: pending approvals, agent blocked, sign off, review decisions, approve AI work.

tools.name: delegate_agent_task
tools.description: Assign work to a specialist AI agent and track the result. Also known as: hand this off, spawn agent, assign task, delegate to agent, have an AI agent do it.

tools.name: track_project_progress
tools.description: Get health, blockers, milestones, owners, and recent activity for a project or initiative. Also known as: project status, initiative pulse, blockers, roadmap progress, execution health.

tools.name: get_pending_decisions
tools.description: List agent decisions and work items awaiting human approval. Also known as: pending approvals, agent blocked, sign off, review decisions, approve AI work.

tools.name: approve_decision
tools.description: Approve a pending agent decision after explicit user confirmation. Also known as: sign off, approve AI work, unblock agent, accept decision.

tools.name: reject_decision
tools.description: Reject a pending agent decision with guidance after explicit user confirmation. Also known as: request revisions, send feedback, decline decision.

tools.name: get_agent_status
tools.description: Show current AI agent activity, blocked work, and execution state. Also known as: agent status, what agents are doing, active runs.

tools.name: query_org_memory
tools.description: Search team memory, organizational decisions, prior artifacts, and project context across agents. Also known as: search memory, recall decisions, find context, retrieve artifacts, project memory.

tools.name: get_initiative_pulse
tools.description: Get project health, blockers, milestones, owners, and recent activity for an initiative. Also known as: project status, roadmap progress, execution health, blockers.

tools.name: spawn_agent_task
tools.description: Delegate work to a specialist AI agent and track the assigned task. Also known as: hand this off, assign task, spawn agent, have an agent do it, autonomous work.

tools.name: get_decision_history
tools.description: Recall past decisions about a topic, project, customer, feature, or artifact. Also known as: decision log, what did we decide, prior approvals.

tools.name: get_morning_brief
tools.description: Summarize overnight agent activity, important changes, pending approvals, and ROI deltas. Also known as: morning brief, executive readout, agent digest.

tools.name: orgx_bootstrap
tools.description: Discover workspace context, granted scopes, safe first calls, and recommended OrgX workflows. Also known as: bootstrap, setup, tool routing.

tools.name: orgx_describe_tool
tools.description: Return the live contract for an OrgX tool, including fields, auth, and next-step guidance. Also known as: tool schema, tool help, contract.

tools.name: orgx_describe_action
tools.description: Describe lifecycle actions, aliases, and payload requirements before changing OrgX entities. Also known as: action help, status change help.

tools.name: start_plan_session
tools.description: Start a multi-agent planning session that breaks a goal into projects, tasks, owners, and agent assignments. Also known as: plan feature, roadmap planning.

tools.name: get_active_sessions
tools.description: Find active planning sessions so agents can continue prior planning context. Also known as: resume planning, active plans, session context.

tools.name: resume_plan_session
tools.description: Resume a planning session by UUID, orgx:// URI, or most recent active session. Also known as: continue plan, reload planning context.

tools.name: improve_plan
tools.description: Improve a plan with AI suggestions based on prior patterns and best practices. Also known as: plan critique, planning feedback, refine plan.

tools.name: record_plan_edit
tools.description: Record a plan edit so OrgX can preserve planning context and learn patterns. Also known as: save plan change, plan memory.

tools.name: complete_plan
tools.description: Complete a planning session and attach implementation details to durable work context. Also known as: finish plan, implementation record.

tools.name: studio_brand_ingest
tools.description: Ingest brand sources and create/update a Content Studio brand pack.

tools.name: studio_content_create
tools.description: Generate branded visual content (carousel, post, story, video, banner, thumbnail).

tools.name: studio_library_search
tools.description: Search the Content Studio library by filters and text.

tools.name: studio_brands_list
tools.description: List available Content Studio brands for the user/org.

tools.name: get_org_snapshot
tools.description: Get an organization-wide execution snapshot across initiatives, work, blockers, and context. Also known as: org status, team overview.

tools.name: account_status
tools.description: Get current account tier, usage, and hourly MCP rate-limit status.

tools.name: account_upgrade
tools.description: Start a plan upgrade or agent credit top-up flow and return a checkout or contact URL after explicit user confirmation. Does not charge automatically.

tools.name: account_usage_report
tools.description: Get detailed usage metrics and current edge rate-limit allowance.

tools.name: list_entities
tools.description: List projects, tasks, milestones, decisions, agents, artifacts, and other OrgX records. Also known as: browse work, find entities.

tools.name: create_entity
tools.description: Create durable work records such as tasks, milestones, decisions, artifacts, or initiatives. Also known as: save work item, add record.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create an actionable task in organizational memory for a project, milestone, or agent. Also known as: add task, create work item.

tools.name: create_milestone
tools.description: Create a project milestone or phase checkpoint with durable context. Also known as: add milestone, create checkpoint.

tools.name: create_decision
tools.description: Record a decision in organizational memory so agents can recall it later. Also known as: remember decision, decision log, team memory.

tools.name: batch_create_entities
tools.description: Create multiple work records in one call for planning and scaffolding. Also known as: bulk create tasks, batch project setup.

tools.name: scaffold_initiative
tools.description: Turn a goal, roadmap, launch, or feature plan into executable workstreams, milestones, and tasks. Also known as: scaffold project, create roadmap.

tools.name: get_task_with_context
tools.description: Fetch a task with linked decisions, artifacts, entities, and plan-session context. Also known as: task context, work brief.

tools.name: update_entity
tools.description: Update fields on an existing task, project, milestone, decision, or artifact. Also known as: edit work item, update context.

tools.name: entity_action
tools.description: Change work state, attach artifacts, or run lifecycle actions on OrgX records. Also known as: launch, pause, complete, attach proof.

tools.name: validate_studio_content
tools.description: Validate a studio_content entity without composing a generic entity_action payload manually.

tools.name: pin_workstream
tools.description: Pin a workstream to the top of the Next Up queue without composing a generic queue action manually.

tools.name: batch_delete_entities
tools.description: Delete multiple entities in one call using the 'delete' lifecycle action (hard delete).

tools.name: configure_org
tools.description: Check setup status, configure agents, or set org policies

tools.name: workspace
tools.description: List, get, or set workspace context

tools.name: stats
tools.description: Get personal or session statistics
